blurb: Prestigious Gibbons & Wheelan home in the gated Grand Island community, with a tiered stone-entry staircase and stacked-stone pillars.
description: Prestigious Gibbons & Wheelan home located in the gated Grand Island community at Seven Oaks. An elegant tiered stone-entry staircase, stacked-stone pillars, manicured landscaping, exposed rafter-tail eaves, and a rock-accented elevation create exceptional curb appeal. Custom double wrought-iron entry doors with hand-forged scrollwork welcome you inside, where you'll find tray ceilings, custom 20-inch tile flooring, and a desirable three-way split-wing design. The granite kitchen features upscale custom cabinetry, a center island, a wine refrigerator, and a custom backsplash.
